title: Freeport High School
subtitle: NYC april 23-26, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Freeport High School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Empire State Building Observation Deck & Times Square

  • Travel to NYC!
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Empire State Building Observation Deck 
  • Group Exploration of Times Square
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 2: 9/11 Memorial Museum & Food Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Take the Staten Island Ferry
  • Food Tour
  • Visit the 9/11 Memorial Museum
  • Watch a Broadway Show
  • Visit Rockefeller Center
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Metropolitan Museum of Art & DUMBO Neighborhood

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Admission to The Met Cloisters 
  • Self-guided Tour of The Metropolitan Museum of Art
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour Across the Brooklyn Bridge
  • Group Exploration of the DUMBO Neighborhood
  • Admission to Jane’s Carousel 
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 4: Today Show & Depart for Home

  • Attend the Today Show at Rockefeller Plaza
  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Freeport High School, get ready for an unforgettable NYC adventure in 2027! 🗽
introText: From iconic landmarks to world-famous neighborhoods, this New York City experience brings history, culture, and excitement to life at every turn. Students will take in breathtaking views from the Empire State Building, explore the energy of Times Square, visit the 9/11 Memorial, and ride the Staten Island Ferry for unforgettable skyline views. With moments like walking across the Brooklyn Bridge, discovering museums like The Met, and enjoying the magic of a Broadway show, this trip offers the perfect mix of learning, culture, and adventure—an experience your students will never forget!
